title: Building a wardrobe that helps you decide
summary: How personal collections and virtual try-on concepts fit into our approach to shopping.
body: It's hard to tell whether a new piece fits your style when you only see a product photo.
Our Spresso wardrobe and collections work explores a more visual approach: saving finds, arranging pieces you like, and experimenting with virtual try-on experiences.
We're sharing these ideas as development notes. Availability and the limits of try-on accuracy depend on the particular feature and version of the app.
This is one piece of the broader goal: shopping assistance that remembers the context of your decisions.
